zh-CN.guidance.chrome.heading: 第一关引导
zh-CN.guidance.wake: 用 {move_left}/{move_right} 移动，跟随峡谷道路。
zh-CN.guidance.attack: 按 {attack_mode} 选择攻击模式，按 {grapple_mode} 选择机械爪模式；用 {slot_1}/{slot_2}/{slot_3}/{slot_4} 选择装备，{primary} 执行当前模式并会消耗能量，停手后恢复。
zh-CN.guidance.grapple: 按 {grapple_mode} 切换机械爪，瞄准发亮的粗糙墙面、平台边缘或天花板并按住 {primary}。用 {move_left}/{move_right} 摆荡、{move_up}/{move_down} 收放绳；连接时按 {jump} 跃升一次，松开 {primary} 脱离。冰面和封闭表面不可抓。
zh-CN.guidance.reach_basin: 继续用 {move_left}/{move_right} 下行；冰面和封闭表面不可抓，失误会落到安全平台。
zh-CN.guidance.shield: 按住 {shield} 朝鼠标举盾；护盾消耗能量并积累热量，过热后需等待冷却。
zh-CN.guidance.climb: 连接后用 {move_left}/{move_right} 摆荡、{move_up}/{move_down} 收放绳；{jump} 只在连接时跃升一次，松开 {primary} 脱离。
zh-CN.guidance.enter_temple: 沿高处向右进入遗落机械神殿。
zh-CN.guidance.mechanism: 按 {grapple_mode}，瞄准神殿机关并按住 {primary} 拉动；随后点亮检查点。
zh-CN.guidance.boss_enter: 向右跨过门槛，唤醒失落守钟人。
zh-CN.guidance.boss: 按 {attack_mode} 并用 {primary} 攻击；按住 {shield} 抵挡正面招式并留意过热。
zh-CN.guidance.boss_chain: 锁链已暴露：按 {grapple_mode}，瞄准锁链并按住 {primary}。
zh-CN.guidance.hint.descent: 粗糙石面可抓，冰面和封闭表面不可抓；在安全平台上重试。
zh-CN.guidance.hint.basin: 护盾朝向鼠标；过热时松开 {shield} 等待冷却。
zh-CN.guidance.hint.ascent: 用 {move_left}/{move_right} 加速摆荡，{move_up}/{move_down} 调整绳长。
zh-CN.guidance.hint.temple: 用 {attack_mode}/{grapple_mode} 明确选择下一动作，不要只看鼠标目标。

en.guidance.chrome.heading: First-Level Guidance
en.guidance.wake: Move with {move_left}/{move_right} and follow the canyon path.
en.guidance.attack: Press {attack_mode} for Attack mode or {grapple_mode} for mechanical-claw mode; choose slots {slot_1}/{slot_2}/{slot_3}/{slot_4}. {primary} performs the current mode and spends energy, which regenerates after you stop.
en.guidance.grapple: Press {grapple_mode} to switch to the mechanical claw. Aim at a glowing rough wall, platform edge, or ceiling and hold {primary}. Swing with {move_left}/{move_right} and reel with {move_up}/{move_down}; while attached, press {jump} for one boost, then release {primary} to detach. Ice and sealed surfaces cannot be grappled.
en.guidance.reach_basin: Continue down with {move_left}/{move_right}. Ice and sealed surfaces cannot be grappled; mistakes land on a safe platform.
en.guidance.shield: Hold {shield} to face the shield toward the mouse. It drains energy and builds heat; wait for overheat to cool.
en.guidance.climb: While attached, swing with {move_left}/{move_right} and reel with {move_up}/{move_down}; {jump} gives one attached boost, and release {primary} to detach.
en.guidance.enter_temple: Continue right along the high path into the Lost Temple.
en.guidance.mechanism: Press {grapple_mode}, aim at the temple mechanism, and hold {primary} to pull it; then light the checkpoint.
en.guidance.boss_enter: Cross the threshold to wake the Fallen Bellkeeper.
en.guidance.boss: Press {attack_mode} and use {primary} to attack. Hold {shield} against frontal strikes and watch for overheat.
en.guidance.boss_chain: The chain is exposed: press {grapple_mode}, aim at it, and hold {primary}.
en.guidance.hint.descent: Rough stone can be grappled; ice and sealed surfaces cannot. Retry from the safe platform.
en.guidance.hint.basin: Face the shield toward the mouse; release {shield} and wait when overheated.
en.guidance.hint.ascent: Build swing with {move_left}/{move_right}; adjust rope length with {move_up}/{move_down}.
en.guidance.hint.temple: Choose the next action explicitly with {attack_mode}/{grapple_mode}; cursor context never changes mode.
